review_notes: I read the whole file and compared its simp lemmas with the level-one analogues in GLn/DiagonalCosets.lean and GLn/Degree.lean. I also checked how diagCosetGamma0 is used downstream (Gamma0/Diagonal/ScalarMul.lean, PrimePower.lean, Nebentypus/Scalar.lean). The simp lemmas diagCosetGamma0_toSet, toLevelOneCoset_diagCosetGamma0, diagCosetGamma0_one and diagCosetGamma0_of_not_pos look well oriented, and I see no cycle. diagCosetGamma0_def is deliberately not simp. The one concrete problem is that the scalar and identity simp lemmas only match the `fun _ ↦ c` spelling, while the main downstream uses write `![c, c]`. I could not run Lean, so I do not claim any simp failure was observed. I did not find a Mathlib simp lemma that rewrites `![c, c]` to `fun _ ↦ c`: `Matrix.vecCons_const` is not marked simp in this commit, and in any case it would not fire on `![c, c]` directly.

findings.problem: The scalar simp lemmas are stated only for the `fun _ ↦ c` spelling of the constant tuple. Downstream code writes the same scalar coset as `diagCosetGamma0 N ![c, c] ...` and `![p, p]`. In Nebentypus/Scalar.lean, PrimePower.lean and this file's own `doubleCoset_out_diagCosetGamma0_const_eq_iUnion_rightCosets`, the `![c, c]` spelling is used. `![c, c]` is `vecCons c ![c]`, not syntactically `fun _ ↦ c`, and Mathlib's `Matrix.vecCons_const` is not a simp lemma here. So `degree_diagCosetGamma0_const` and `diagCosetGamma0_one` cannot fire on these terms, and `![1, 1]` is not normalised to `1` either. The file works around this with a manual `hvec : ![c, c] = fun _ : Fin 2 ↦ c` and `simpa only [hvec]`. Each use of `![c, c]` also needs the ad hoc coprimality proof `fun h ↦ by simpa using hcN (by simpa using h 0)`. The simp set therefore has two non-unified normal forms for the same coset.
findings.proposed_change: Add a simp lemma for the pair spelling, for example `@[simp] theorem degree_diagCosetGamma0_pair_self (c : ℕ) (hgcd) : (diagCosetGamma0 N ![c, c] hgcd).degree = 1`, proved via the existing lemma and `hvec`. Alternatively, add a simp lemma `diagCosetGamma0 N ![c, c] hgcd = diagCosetGamma0 N (fun _ ↦ c) hgcd'`, or a `![1, 1]` variant of `diagCosetGamma0_one`. Choose one canonical spelling (the `fun _ ↦ c` form) and state the `hvec` conversion once as a simp lemma, instead of repeating it inside proofs.
findings.benefit: Degree and identity facts for scalar cosets then fire automatically on the `![c, c]` terms that the Nebentypus scalar-action theorems and `PrimePower` actually use. The local `hvec` rewrite goes away, and the two spellings of one coset stop being separate simp-normal forms.
